rounds.text: Patspin India Ltd presents a compelling case of operational turnaround, evidenced by an ROE of 25.33% that significantly outperforms the sector benchmark of 5.37% [E8]. This efficiency is supported by accelerating earnings growth [E53], which has contributed to a 17% compounded profit growth over the last three years [E17]. The market currently undervalues this momentum, as the stock trades at a P/B ratio of 0x compared to the sector median of 1.24x [E6]. Furthermore, the company is demonstrating a fundamental shift where profit growth is outpacing one-year price growth by 30%, signaling that the business is beginning to exceed market expectations [E45]. Conceded: the company faces headwinds with a poor five-year sales growth of -20.7% [E49], a trailing twelve-month profit decline of -6% [E18], and a negative ROA of -14.64% [E7]. Despite these challenges, the current valuation at a P/B of -0.48x suggests that the market has priced in extreme pessimism that is increasingly disconnected from the company's recent profit growth trajectory [E1].
